title: Refund Order between a Resident Funds Transfer and Other Payments on a Bed-Hold Charge
content:
When a bed-hold charge under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations was overpaid, and it was paid partly by a transfer from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account and partly by other payments, the excess is shared between the transfer and the charge's other payments in the bed-hold refund order. The charge's other payments are the payments naming it less the transfers from this account naming it. The bed-hold refund order sets **the transfer's portion** of the excess, from which the return is figured.

| When the charge's other payments were made | Transfer's portion |
|---|---|
| a payment other than the transfer named the charge on a later date than the transfer | the other payments are refunded first; the transfer's portion is what remains of the excess after them, never below zero |
| another payment named the charge on the transfer's own date | the excess multiplied by the transfer, divided by the transfer plus the other payments |
| otherwise | the whole excess |

The first row that fits decides.

## Hypothetical illustration

Excess $504.00; transfer $1260.00; other payments by card $420.00.

| Date of the card payment | Transfer's portion |
|---|---|
| after the transfer | $504.00 less $420.00: $84.00 |
| same day as the transfer | $504.00 times 1260.00 divided by 1680.00: $378.00 |
| before the transfer | $504.00 |
